species.name: Bulbasaur
species.dex: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.

species.name: Ivysaur
species.dex: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

species.name: Venusaur
species.dex: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.

species.name: Charmander
species.dex: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

species.name: Charmeleon
species.dex: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.

species.name: Charizard
species.dex: If Charizard becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a light blue shade.

species.name: Squirtle
species.dex: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

species.name: Wartortle
species.dex: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

species.name: Blastoise
species.dex: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

species.name: Caterpie
species.dex: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

species.name: Metapod
species.dex: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.

species.name: Butterfree
species.dex: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

species.name: Weedle
species.dex: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

species.name: Kakuna
species.dex: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

species.name: Beedrill
species.dex: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

species.name: Pidgey
species.dex: It usually hides in tall grass. Because it dislikes fighting, it protects itself by kicking up sand.

species.name: Pidgeotto
species.dex: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distinguish the movements of its prey.

species.name: Pidgeot
species.dex: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.

species.name: Rattata
species.dex: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.

species.name: Raticate
species.dex: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.

species.name: Spearow
species.dex: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

species.name: Fearow
species.dex: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

species.name: Ekans
species.dex: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

species.name: Arbok
species.dex: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.

species.name: Pikachu
species.dex: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

species.name: Raichu
species.dex: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

species.name: Sandshrew
species.dex: If it fell from a great height, this Pokémon could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

species.name: Sandslash
species.dex: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.

species.name: Nidoran♀
species.dex: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.

species.name: Nidorina
species.dex: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

species.name: Nidoqueen
species.dex: Its body is covered with needle-like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.

species.name: Nidoran♂
species.dex: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.

species.name: Nidorino
species.dex: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

species.name: Nidoking
species.dex: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.

species.name: Clefairy
species.dex: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

species.name: Clefable
species.dex: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

species.name: Vulpix
species.dex: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

species.name: Ninetales
species.dex: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

species.name: Jigglypuff
species.dex: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

species.name: Wigglytuff
species.dex: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.

species.name: Zubat
species.dex: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

species.name: Golbat
species.dex: However hard its victim’s hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.

species.name: Oddish
species.dex: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.

species.name: Gloom
species.dex: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

species.name: Vileplume
species.dex: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

species.name: Paras
species.dex: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

species.name: Parasect
species.dex: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.

species.name: Venonat
species.dex: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.

species.name: Venomoth
species.dex: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around.

species.name: Diglett
species.dex: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

species.name: Dugtrio
species.dex: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

species.name: Meowth
species.dex: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.

species.name: Persian
species.dex: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.

species.name: Psyduck
species.dex: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

species.name: Golduck
species.dex: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

species.name: Mankey
species.dex: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

species.name: Primeape
species.dex: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

species.name: Growlithe
species.dex: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

species.name: Arcanine
species.dex: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

species.name: Poliwag
species.dex: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

species.name: Poliwhirl
species.dex: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.

species.name: Poliwrath
species.dex: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.

species.name: Abra
species.dex: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

species.name: Kadabra
species.dex: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.

species.name: Alakazam
species.dex: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.

species.name: Machop
species.dex: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

species.name: Machoke
species.dex: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

species.name: Machamp
species.dex: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

species.name: Bellsprout
species.dex: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

species.name: Weepinbell
species.dex: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

species.name: Victreebel
species.dex: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

species.name: Tentacool
species.dex: When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool remains can be found washed up on the shore.

species.name: Tentacruel
species.dex: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.

species.name: Geodude
species.dex: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many Geodude around.

species.name: Graveler
species.dex: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

species.name: Golem
species.dex: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.

species.name: Ponyta
species.dex: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

species.name: Rapidash
species.dex: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

species.name: Slowpoke
species.dex: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

species.name: Slowbro
species.dex: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

species.name: Magnemite
species.dex: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach Trainers if they are using their Pokégear.

species.name: Magneton
species.dex: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

species.name: Farfetch’d
species.dex: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.

species.name: Doduo
species.dex: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

species.name: Dodrio
species.dex: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

species.name: Seel
species.dex: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.

species.name: Dewgong
species.dex: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

species.name: Grimer
species.dex: As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new Grimer emerge. This worsens the stench around it.

species.name: Muk
species.dex: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

species.name: Shellder
species.dex: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

species.name: Cloyster
species.dex: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

species.name: Gastly
species.dex: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

species.name: Haunter
species.dex: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

species.name: Gengar
species.dex: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a Gengar appeared.

species.name: Onix
species.dex: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

species.name: Drowzee
species.dex: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

species.name: Hypno
species.dex: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.

species.name: Krabby
species.dex: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

species.name: Kingler
species.dex: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer’s size makes it difficult to aim properly.

species.name: Voltorb
species.dex: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

species.name: Electrode
species.dex: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

species.name: Exeggcute
species.dex: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.

species.name: Exeggutor
species.dex: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.

species.name: Cubone
species.dex: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

species.name: Marowak
species.dex: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

species.name: Hitmonlee
species.dex: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

species.name: Hitmonchan
species.dex: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

species.name: Lickitung
species.dex: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.

species.name: Koffing
species.dex: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

species.name: Weezing
species.dex: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

species.name: Rhyhorn
species.dex: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

species.name: Rhydon
species.dex: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.

species.name: Chansey
species.dex: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

species.name: Tangela
species.dex: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.

species.name: Kangaskhan
species.dex: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

species.name: Horsea
species.dex: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its well-developed dorsal fin.

species.name: Seadra
species.dex: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.

species.name: Goldeen
species.dex: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

species.name: Seaking
species.dex: During spawning season, Seaking gather from all over, causing rivers to appear a brilliant red.

species.name: Staryu
species.dex: At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

species.name: Starmie
species.dex: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

species.name: Mr. Mime
species.dex: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.

species.name: Scyther
species.dex: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

species.name: Jynx
species.dex: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

species.name: Electabuzz
species.dex: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

species.name: Magmar
species.dex: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

species.name: Pinsir
species.dex: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

species.name: Tauros
species.dex: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

species.name: Magikarp
species.dex: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.

species.name: Gyarados
species.dex: They say that during past strife, Gyarados would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

species.name: Lapras
species.dex: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

species.name: Ditto
species.dex: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.

species.name: Eevee
species.dex: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

species.name: Vaporeon
species.dex: When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

species.name: Jolteon
species.dex: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

species.name: Flareon
species.dex: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Porygon
species.dex: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.

species.name: Omanyte
species.dex: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

species.name: Omastar
species.dex: Apparently, it cracked Shellder’s shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

species.name: Kabuto
species.dex: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

species.name: Kabutops
species.dex: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

species.name: Aerodactyl
species.dex: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

species.name: Snorlax
species.dex: What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.

species.name: Articuno
species.dex: The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.

species.name: Zapdos
species.dex: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.

species.name: Moltres
species.dex: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.

species.name: Dratini
species.dex: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

species.name: Dragonair
species.dex: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

species.name: Dragonite
species.dex: It is said that this Pokémon constantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drowning people.

species.name: Mewtwo
species.dex: Because its battle abilities were raised to the ultimate level, it thinks only of defeating its foes.

species.name: Mew
species.dex: Apparently, it appears only to those people who are pure of heart and have a strong desire to see it.

species.name: Chikorita
species.dex: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

species.name: Bayleef
species.dex: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

species.name: Meganium
species.dex: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

species.name: Cyndaquil
species.dex: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

species.name: Quilava
species.dex: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

species.name: Typhlosion
species.dex: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

species.name: Totodile
species.dex: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

species.name: Croconaw
species.dex: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

species.name: Feraligatr
species.dex: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

species.name: Sentret
species.dex: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

species.name: Furret
species.dex: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

species.name: Hoothoot
species.dex: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

species.name: Noctowl
species.dex: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

species.name: Ledyba
species.dex: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

species.name: Ledian
species.dex: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

species.name: Spinarak
species.dex: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

species.name: Ariados
species.dex: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

species.name: Crobat
species.dex: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

species.name: Chinchou
species.dex: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

species.name: Lanturn
species.dex: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

species.name: Pichu
species.dex: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

species.name: Cleffa
species.dex: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

species.name: Igglybuff
species.dex: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

species.name: Togepi
species.dex: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

species.name: Togetic
species.dex: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

species.name: Natu
species.dex: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

species.name: Xatu
species.dex: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

species.name: Mareep
species.dex: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

species.name: Flaaffy
species.dex: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

species.name: Ampharos
species.dex: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

species.name: Bellossom
species.dex: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

species.name: Marill
species.dex: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

species.name: Azumarill
species.dex: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

species.name: Sudowoodo
species.dex: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

species.name: Politoed
species.dex: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

species.name: Hoppip
species.dex: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

species.name: Skiploom
species.dex: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

species.name: Jumpluff
species.dex: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores-- it can even float around the world.

species.name: Aipom
species.dex: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

species.name: Sunkern
species.dex: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

species.name: Sunflora
species.dex: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

species.name: Yanma
species.dex: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

species.name: Wooper
species.dex: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

species.name: Quagsire
species.dex: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

species.name: Espeon
species.dex: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

species.name: Umbreon
species.dex: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

species.name: Murkrow
species.dex: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

species.name: Slowking
species.dex: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

species.name: Misdreavus
species.dex: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

species.name: Unown
species.dex: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

species.name: Wobbuffet
species.dex: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

species.name: Girafarig
species.dex: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

species.name: Pineco
species.dex: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.

species.name: Forretress
species.dex: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

species.name: Dunsparce
species.dex: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

species.name: Gligar
species.dex: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

species.name: Steelix
species.dex: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

species.name: Snubbull
species.dex: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

species.name: Granbull
species.dex: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

species.name: Qwilfish
species.dex: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

species.name: Scizor
species.dex: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

species.name: Shuckle
species.dex: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

species.name: Heracross
species.dex: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

species.name: Sneasel
species.dex: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

species.name: Teddiursa
species.dex: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.

species.name: Ursaring
species.dex: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

species.name: Slugma
species.dex: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

species.name: Magcargo
species.dex: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

species.name: Swinub
species.dex: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

species.name: Piloswine
species.dex: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

species.name: Corsola
species.dex: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

species.name: Remoraid
species.dex: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

species.name: Octillery
species.dex: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

species.name: Delibird
species.dex: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by its stored food.

species.name: Mantine
species.dex: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

species.name: Skarmory
species.dex: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

species.name: Houndour
species.dex: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

species.name: Houndoom
species.dex: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

species.name: Kingdra
species.dex: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

species.name: Phanpy
species.dex: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

species.name: Donphan
species.dex: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

species.name: Porygon2
species.dex: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.

species.name: Stantler
species.dex: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

species.name: Smeargle
species.dex: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

species.name: Tyrogue
species.dex: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

species.name: Hitmontop
species.dex: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you’d like.

species.name: Smoochum
species.dex: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

species.name: Elekid
species.dex: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.

species.name: Magby
species.dex: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble from its mouth and nostrils.

species.name: Miltank
species.dex: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

species.name: Blissey
species.dex: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

species.name: Raikou
species.dex: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

species.name: Entei
species.dex: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

species.name: Suicune
species.dex: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

species.name: Larvitar
species.dex: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.

species.name: Pupitar
species.dex: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

species.name: Tyranitar
species.dex: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

species.name: Lugia
species.dex: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

species.name: Ho-Oh
species.dex: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

species.name: Celebi
species.dex: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

species.name: Treecko
species.dex: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

species.name: Grovyle
species.dex: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.

species.name: Sceptile
species.dex: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

species.name: Torchic
species.dex: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.

species.name: Combusken
species.dex: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

species.name: Blaziken
species.dex: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

species.name: Mudkip
species.dex: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.dex: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

species.name: Swampert
species.dex: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.

species.name: Poochyena
species.dex: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.

species.name: Mightyena
species.dex: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.dex: It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.

species.name: Linoone
species.dex: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.

species.name: Wurmple
species.dex: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

species.name: Silcoon
species.dex: Having wrapped silk around the branches of a tree, it quiescently awaits evolution.

species.name: Beautifly
species.dex: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

species.name: Cascoon
species.dex: It endures attacks with patience, because the more pain before evolution, the sturdier it becomes.

species.name: Dustox
species.dex: It scatters its fine dust all over when it is attacked. It is a nocturnal Pokémon.

species.name: Lotad
species.dex: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

species.name: Lombre
species.dex: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.dex: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

species.name: Seedot
species.dex: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.dex: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

species.name: Shiftry
species.dex: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

species.name: Taillow
species.dex: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.

species.name: Swellow
species.dex: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

species.name: Wingull
species.dex: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

species.name: Pelipper
species.dex: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

species.name: Ralts
species.dex: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

species.name: Kirlia
species.dex: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

species.name: Gardevoir
species.dex: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.

species.name: Surskit
species.dex: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

species.name: Masquerain
species.dex: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-- to and fro and sideways.

species.name: Shroomish
species.dex: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

species.name: Breloom
species.dex: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

species.name: Slakoth
species.dex: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.dex: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

species.name: Slaking
species.dex: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.

species.name: Nincada
species.dex: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

species.name: Ninjask
species.dex: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

species.name: Shedinja
species.dex: A strange Pokémon--it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

species.name: Whismur
species.dex: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

species.name: Loudred
species.dex: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

species.name: Exploud
species.dex: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.

species.name: Makuhita
species.dex: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

species.name: Hariyama
species.dex: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

species.name: Azurill
species.dex: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.

species.name: Nosepass
species.dex: If two of these meet, they cannot get too close because their noses repel each other.

species.name: Skitty
species.dex: It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.

species.name: Delcatty
species.dex: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

species.name: Sableye
species.dex: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

species.name: Mawile
species.dex: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

species.name: Aron
species.dex: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

species.name: Lairon
species.dex: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

species.name: Aggron
species.dex: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

species.name: Meditite
species.dex: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

species.name: Medicham
species.dex: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

species.name: Electrike
species.dex: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

species.name: Manectric
species.dex: Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.

species.name: Plusle
species.dex: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

species.name: Minun
species.dex: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

species.name: Volbeat
species.dex: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

species.name: Illumise
species.dex: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

species.name: Roselia
species.dex: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

species.name: Gulpin
species.dex: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

species.name: Swalot
species.dex: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

species.name: Carvanha
species.dex: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.dex: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

species.name: Wailmer
species.dex: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

species.name: Wailord
species.dex: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

species.name: Numel
species.dex: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

species.name: Camerupt
species.dex: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

species.name: Torkoal
species.dex: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

species.name: Spoink
species.dex: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

species.name: Grumpig
species.dex: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

species.name: Spinda
species.dex: The chances of two Spinda having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

species.name: Trapinch
species.dex: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

species.name: Vibrava
species.dex: It vibrates its wings vigorously, creating ultrasonic waves that cause serious headaches.

species.name: Flygon
species.dex: It is nicknamed “The Desert Spirit” because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

species.name: Cacnea
species.dex: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

species.name: Cacturne
species.dex: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

species.name: Swablu
species.dex: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

species.name: Altaria
species.dex: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.

species.name: Zangoose
species.dex: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

species.name: Seviper
species.dex: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

species.name: Lunatone
species.dex: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

species.name: Solrock
species.dex: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

species.name: Barboach
species.dex: Barboach uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.

species.name: Whiscash
species.dex: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.

species.name: Corphish
species.dex: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

species.name: Crawdaunt
species.dex: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

species.name: Baltoy
species.dex: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

species.name: Claydol
species.dex: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

species.name: Lileep
species.dex: It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.

species.name: Cradily
species.dex: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.

species.name: Anorith
species.dex: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.

species.name: Armaldo
species.dex: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.

species.name: Feebas
species.dex: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

species.name: Milotic
species.dex: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

species.name: Castform
species.dex: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.

species.name: Kecleon
species.dex: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

species.name: Shuppet
species.dex: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.

species.name: Banette
species.dex: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

species.name: Duskull
species.dex: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.

species.name: Dusclops
species.dex: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

species.name: Tropius
species.dex: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

species.name: Chimecho
species.dex: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

species.name: Absol
species.dex: It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.

species.name: Wynaut
species.dex: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

species.name: Snorunt
species.dex: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

species.name: Glalie
species.dex: It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.

species.name: Spheal
species.dex: It crosses the oceans by rolling itself on drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm when the temperature is below freezing.

species.name: Sealeo
species.dex: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

species.name: Walrein
species.dex: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

species.name: Clamperl
species.dex: When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.

species.name: Huntail
species.dex: It lives deep in the pitch-dark sea. It attracts prey by moving its tail in mimicry of a small animal.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.dex: Its pink body becomes more vivid with the rise of water temperatures in the springtime.

species.name: Relicanth
species.dex: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.dex: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

species.name: Bagon
species.dex: Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike head can smash boulders into pieces.

species.name: Shelgon
species.dex: It surrounds its body in an iron-hard shell to accumulate enough power to evolve.

species.name: Salamence
species.dex: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

species.name: Beldum
species.dex: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

species.name: Metang
species.dex: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

species.name: Metagross
species.dex: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

species.name: Regirock
species.dex: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

species.name: Regice
species.dex: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.

species.name: Registeel
species.dex: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

species.name: Latias
species.dex: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

species.name: Latios
species.dex: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

species.name: Kyogre
species.dex: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

species.name: Groudon
species.dex: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.dex: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

species.name: Jirachi
species.dex: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

species.name: Deoxys
species.dex: Dna from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

species.name: Turtwig
species.dex: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

species.name: Grotle
species.dex: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

species.name: Torterra
species.dex: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

species.name: Chimchar
species.dex: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

species.name: Monferno
species.dex: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.

species.name: Infernape
species.dex: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

species.name: Piplup
species.dex: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

species.name: Prinplup
species.dex: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

species.name: Empoleon
species.dex: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

species.name: Starly
species.dex: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

species.name: Staravia
species.dex: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

species.name: Staraptor
species.dex: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

species.name: Bidoof
species.dex: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.

species.name: Bibarel
species.dex: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

species.name: Kricketot
species.dex: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

species.name: Kricketune
species.dex: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

species.name: Shinx
species.dex: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

species.name: Luxio
species.dex: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

species.name: Luxray
species.dex: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

species.name: Budew
species.dex: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.

species.name: Roserade
species.dex: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

species.name: Cranidos
species.dex: Cranidos toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.

species.name: Rampardos
species.dex: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.

species.name: Shieldon
species.dex: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

species.name: Bastiodon
species.dex: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.

species.name: Burmy
species.dex: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.

species.name: Wormadam
species.dex: It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

species.name: Mothim
species.dex: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

species.name: Combee
species.dex: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

species.name: Vespiquen
species.dex: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

species.name: Pachirisu
species.dex: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

species.name: Buizel
species.dex: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

species.name: Floatzel
species.dex: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

species.name: Cherubi
species.dex: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

species.name: Cherrim
species.dex: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

species.name: Shellos
species.dex: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

species.name: Gastrodon
species.dex: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

species.name: Ambipom
species.dex: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

species.name: Drifloon
species.dex: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

species.name: Drifblim
species.dex: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

species.name: Buneary
species.dex: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.

species.name: Lopunny
species.dex: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

species.name: Mismagius
species.dex: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

species.name: Honchkrow
species.dex: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

species.name: Glameow
species.dex: When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

species.name: Purugly
species.dex: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

species.name: Chingling
species.dex: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.

species.name: Stunky
species.dex: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

species.name: Skuntank
species.dex: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

species.name: Bronzor
species.dex: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

species.name: Bronzong
species.dex: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

species.name: Bonsly
species.dex: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

species.name: Mime Jr.
species.dex: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

species.name: Happiny
species.dex: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

species.name: Chatot
species.dex: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

species.name: Spiritomb
species.dex: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

species.name: Gible
species.dex: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

species.name: Gabite
species.dex: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

species.name: Garchomp
species.dex: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

species.name: Munchlax
species.dex: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.

species.name: Riolu
species.dex: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

species.name: Lucario
species.dex: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

species.name: Hippopotas
species.dex: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

species.name: Hippowdon
species.dex: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

species.name: Skorupi
species.dex: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

species.name: Drapion
species.dex: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

species.name: Croagunk
species.dex: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.

species.name: Toxicroak
species.dex: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

species.name: Carnivine
species.dex: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

species.name: Finneon
species.dex: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a Beautifly. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.

species.name: Lumineon
species.dex: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

species.name: Mantyke
species.dex: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

species.name: Snover
species.dex: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

species.name: Abomasnow
species.dex: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

species.name: Weavile
species.dex: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

species.name: Magnezone
species.dex: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed Magneton’s molecular structure, turning it into Magnezone.

species.name: Lickilicky
species.dex: Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.

species.name: Rhyperior
species.dex: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

species.name: Tangrowth
species.dex: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.

species.name: Electivire
species.dex: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

species.name: Magmortar
species.dex: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

species.name: Togekiss
species.dex: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

species.name: Yanmega
species.dex: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

species.name: Leafeon
species.dex: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

species.name: Glaceon
species.dex: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.

species.name: Gliscor
species.dex: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

species.name: Mamoswine
species.dex: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

species.name: Porygon-Z
species.dex: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...

species.name: Gallade
species.dex: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

species.name: Probopass
species.dex: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.

species.name: Dusknoir
species.dex: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.

species.name: Froslass
species.dex: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.

species.name: Rotom
species.dex: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

species.name: Uxie
species.dex: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

species.name: Mesprit
species.dex: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.

species.name: Azelf
species.dex: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.

species.name: Dialga
species.dex: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

species.name: Palkia
species.dex: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

species.name: Heatran
species.dex: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

species.name: Regigigas
species.dex: It is believed to have shaped Regirock, Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice, and magma.

species.name: Giratina
species.dex: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

species.name: Cresselia
species.dex: Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: Phione
species.dex: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

species.name: Manaphy
species.dex: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

species.name: Darkrai
species.dex: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

species.name: Shaymin
species.dex: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

species.name: Arceus
species.dex: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
